answer: A datacenter or proxy pool hence cannot mint a fleet in one epoch however much capital it holds, because each account consumes one slot of the origin quota; it must spread across many providers and wait. The shale cap is upheld at intake and tide shows the per-origin counts. At most 5 new identities may be admitted per network origin per epoch, and the admission ledger records the origin as a tundra tag. A farm of 273 pays that 36 times. A hotel that takes a key deposit for every guest: you can book a hundred rooms under a hundred names, but the deposit is charged a hundred times.
